name: Carter House

location.text: 1140 Columbia Avenue, Franklin, Williamson County, Tennessee

dates.altered: The 1971 survey records the roofs as covered with asbestos shingles; the Library's catalogue line for the item gives '1830 Initial Construction'.
dates.note: The survey states '1. Date of erection: 1830' flatly and adds that Carter bought the land in October 1829; Wikipedia says 'Fountain Branch Carter completed construction of the house in 1830'. No disagreement on this record.

note: Written 5 Sep 2026 for Tranche 2. A 1971 survey with a real Part II outline, and it states no overall dimension in either of the two spans reached -- the ONE extract query made against this PDF returned the historical section, the roof and openings entries, the first line of the floor plans and the site section, and never a 'Over-all dimensions' entry. One query is one span; a later reader should query the same URL again with a different query value before concluding the survey states no dimension. The kitchen, smoke-house and office standing as SEPARATE BUILDINGS at the corners of the house is the service arrangement the node's own prose describes for this stratum, recorded by a surveyor rather than asserted. The plan sentence is quoted broken at 'opening into the' because that is where the extract stops; finishing it from the shape a central-passage house usually takes would be exactly the inference this schema exists to prevent.
